{{Quote|I'm looking for humidity sensors. Sandstorm did a number on my vaporators.|A farmer on Tatooine|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''humidity sensor''' was a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that measured humidity levels. They were usually found in control stations monitoring interior environments. The [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] used humidity sensors to control the [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]-[[Water/Legends|moisture]] levels of [[Lars homestead/Legends|their homestead's]] [[Hydroponics/Legends|hydroponic garden]].<ref name="CL" />
